checks.command: cargo test --locked --offline -p fvid-media --test matroska_text_termination_regressions --test matroska_empty_pose_regressions --test matroska_header_stripping_regressions

qualification: Eight accepted authored VP9 video cases cover original control, terminated DocType, CodecID, Unicode track names and optional metadata; each passes native pixels, clocks, seek, rewind and EOF.
Strict UTF-8 validation ignores bytes only after the first NUL. Invalid bytes before it remain rejected. Lossy metadata and chapter titles discard suffix padding too.
Stored element length still controls resource admission; an early NUL does not bypass the byte limit. Retained string capacities remain included in existing index accounting.
Software playback verified; player configuration type-checks. No hardware runtime or performance claim.
counting: One EBML semantic-string termination bug; all field/UTF-8/padding variants are grouped under this ID.
